title: Cost per successful outcome: the AI number Singapore CIOs should be reporting
hook_text: Singapore CIOs need one new number.
script:
Singapore CIOs are currently tracking the wrong AI data.
CIOs should report the cost per successful outcome for every AI project.
This shift moves focus away from vanity metrics like total deployments.
Current reporting often fails to link AI spend to business results.
The CIO role must now prioritize financial accountability for AI experiments.
This metric forces teams to justify every dollar spent on new models.
Would you require this metric for your AI budget?
